messages:
maria: Heads-up — I noticed the role-ttl worker ran at 03:10 but ~120 role expiry events have no audit.actor set. Sample from the pipeline sink: 
```json
{"event":"role.expire","role_id":"eng-oncall","time":"2026-03-20T03:10:12Z","actor":null,"meta":{"origin":"role-ttl","task_id":"ttl-20260320-03"}}
```
jeff: can you paste the worker logs for that run? run `kubectl logs job/role-ttl-worker -n infra --since=1h` might show errors writing audit metadata.
maria: pasted main snippet from the pod logs: 
```
INFO Starting expiry run ttl-20260320-03
INFO processing batch size=250
WARN audit_sink write failed: 403 Forbidden (envelope write ok)
INFO completed 130/260 roles, 130 failures writing audit metadata
```
jeff: 403 on audit_sink is weird — are we using the service account key or a KMS-wrapped envelope? @nate did we rotate the KMS key yesterday?
nate: we rotated the application envelope key at ~02:00 UTC; rotations should be transparent. but I did see the KMS client upgrade (libkms v2.4.0) in the infra job image yesterday. there was one change: the client now refuses to attach non-user principals unless explicitly set. might be dropping the `actor` annotation.
maria: digging — the audit proxy accepted the envelope but the audit_db record shows actor=null. pipeline transformation log shows this: 
```json
{"stage":"unpack_envelope","envelope_meta":{"principal":null,"kms_key":"arn:aws:kms:...:key/abc"}}
```
anita: if actor=null flows to audit DB that's a compliance fail for change tracking. quarterly audit report pulls `count(actor) by role` and compliance will flag missing provenance. @compliance-bot can you queue a notice?
compliance-bot: :warning: Generated compliance alert: 120 missing-audit-actors detected for role expirations on 2026-03-20. Ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-4321
jeff: plan proposal — short term: run a backfill to recover actor by correlating task_id -> job-run -> pod SA; long term: patch ttl worker to explicitly write `actor: service-account/role-ttl` into audit envelope before encryption. also revert libkms if it's blocking metadata attach.
maria: backfill query I'm going to run (dry-run first): 
```sql
SELECT r.role_id, r.event_time, j.pod_sa
FROM role_expiry_raw r
JOIN job_runs j ON r.task_id = j.task_id
WHERE r.actor IS NULL AND r.event_time >= '2026-03-20T02:00:00Z'
```
I'll run this in read-only mode and produce a candidate patch set for audit_db.
nate: quick note — if we reprocess envelopes we must be careful with KMS envelope integrity. prefer reconstructing actor from control-plane job metadata rather than re-encrypting.
jeff: agreed. I'll open SEC-4322 to track the code fix and SEC-4323 for backfill. maria, assign me the fix PR reviewer.
sec-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: High severity — audit-actor-null count=120 (role-ttl) — runbook sec/runbooks/audit-missing-actor.md assigned to @maria and @jeff
anita: please cc compliance@redwood on the ticket. we need an evidence bundle for SOC2.
maria: will do. ETA: backfill dry-run in 2hrs, patch PR opened in 5hrs, hotfix deploy in next maintenance window (6h). posting updates here as they happen. :white_check_mark:
